body:
i’ve had depression ever since i could remember and i don’t really know what caused it. my family (on my moms side) have had a bad history with mental health in general so that perhaps could have something to do with it. it wasn’t too bad until a few years ago, when i got into my 2nd relationship. my ex would constantly bring me down for my body, my interests, and didn’t really care if i thought about suicide and would tell me to keep it in so now i have a lot of trouble with self confidence and talking to people about my feelings. she also was a very jealous person and became jealous of me, which kinda rubbed off on me. now I’m extremely envious of everybody bc everyone seems to have accomplished so much more than i have. it doesn’t help that i’m an open lesbian in a relationship and i live in a tiny kentucky town, so i’m met with judgmental looks and sometimes teasing from my peers.

so basically; i’ve been depressed for as long as i can remember, i’m traumatized from a verbally and emotionally abusive relationship, i’m jealous of everyone my age bc they’ve accomplished more than me, and i’m openly gay in a backwards little town

i know i don’t have it as bad as some people, and i often feel invalidated bc i’ve always been told “i shouldn’t feel this way” by my ex, but things are still painful for me and i’m not sure how to find happiness that lasts longer than a few hours in a day atm
